newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-CHANG PROVES FIGHTING ABILITY TO DOWN BECKER.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CHANG PROVES FIGHTING ABILITY TO DOWN BECKER.

text.p: American Michael Chang on Thursday avenged his defeat by Boris Becker in last year's Australian Open final with a battling win in the last warm-up event for next week's grand slam tournament at Melbourne Park.
Chang, the world number two, showed all his fighting qaulities to edge past Becker 2-6 6-4 7-6 (7-5), saving three match points in the process.
"I am pretty competitive person and the only time I am not is when I'm playing against my mother," Chang said after advancing to the final of the Colonial Classic exhibition event at Kooyong.
"It is in my nature -- any competitive person does not like to lose," said Chang, who will defend his Classic title against either compatriot Pete Sampras or Russian Yevgeny Kafelnikov on Saturday.

Becker, who ended a barren five-year spell without a grand slam victory with his Open triumph in Melbourne last January, led Chang 4-0 in the decisive tie-break before losing an encounter lasting two hours and 18 minutes.
"In a way it was good for me to lose, it makes me a little more hungry," said Becker, the world number six.
"That was a very important match because it was very competitive. It felt like a serious match," said Becker, who described Chang's tenacity as his trademark.
"When you haven't played for a couple of weeks your concentration wanders so it was good practice for my mind as well as my body. I'm kind of glad I had that match," he said.
In other matches involving the losers from the first round, Germany's Michael Stich beat American Jim Courier 6-4 6-3 while Andrei Medvedev of the Ukraine defeated Australian Scott Draper 6-4 6-3.
Draper played as a last-minute replacement for Swede Thomas Enqvist, who was forced to withdraw from the event with a badly infected blister on his right hand.
World number one Sampras will play Kafelnikov, ranked three places below him on the ATP Tour list, on Friday in the other semifinal at Kooyong.
